assertions.source: A^(1/3) requires A = 333.8025906 / 605.7699625 / 1764.298062 against the published 334 / 606 / 1764. A probe that did not reproduce them would be measuring its own method.

assertions.name: hyperbolic_law_strengthens_the_unreachability

assertions.name: verdict_is_not_law_independent
assertions.source: Reachable under: A^(1/2). The bean states unreachability without qualification.

description: Roast of qou-17mq finding 2 by qou-17mq finding 3: the 'saturation is unreachable' verdict is recomputed under each of the four separation laws finding 3 tabulates, anchoring the single scale at the committed alpha_max. Reproduces the published 334/606/1764 for the Euclidean law before departing from it. Nothing fitted, nothing scored; scope (a) on a conditionality the bean does not flag.

A^(1/3).provenance: Euclidean nuclear radius law, as used by finding 2

ln A.provenance: hyperbolic self-consistent (V ~ A in H^3 => R ~ ln)

data.verdict: Finding 2's verdict is NOT law-independent, and the bean states it flatly. It holds under the law the data prefers (A^(1/3), required A = 333.8025906) and is STRENGTHENED under the law the hyperbolic geometry requires (ln A, required A = 1370.469138), but FAILS under A^(1/2) (required A = 191.4726076 <= 294.0), which is one of the four laws finding 3 itself tabulates. A^(1/2) scores worst on scatter (13.95% vs 3.505%), so this is not a live threat -- but that defence is a FIT argument, and finding 3's point is that the fit and the geometry disagree about which law is right. Scope (a): a conditionality the bean does not flag, not a refutation.
